channel.title: Rural Circuits
channel.description: Ideas for a better life on earth. Field notes on regenerative living, homesteading, and gentle technology.

item.title: Swallowed by the Earth
item.description: Sometimes we fall into our own Nightmares.

item.title: Food for the dogs
item.description: Dog kibble has made our dogs itchy, and it’s expensive—despite not delivering on the nutritional value claimed on the plastic bags it comes in. Why not make your own, for healthier dogs, greater resilience, and real money savings?

item.title: Opting Out, Gently
item.description: Resilience is no longer about adapting faster within fragile systems, but about reducing dependency on them. By choosing debt-free living, practical skills, and small, trusted communities, stability becomes something you build locally rather than wait for globally.

item.title: Sourdough Adventures
item.description: Baking with sourdough creates delicious, healthy breads that can delight anyone who tries them.

item.title: Nature is amazing!
item.description: I am overwhelmed with gratitude for the resilience of nature and the quiet wisdom of Mother Earth. She always knows what to do. When we trust that we belong to this place — to this living world — we find that we are held, supported, and guided.

item.title: Introducing Rootstock
item.description: Rootstock is a toolkit for regenerative homesteading — combining local AI, peer-to-peer networking, and open-source sensors.
